#Rust: Combining Domain-Driven Design, #Embedded and #CrossPlatform. No need for AI because of reuse. For Beginners and Advanced Rustaceans.

When your Domain Core runs unchanged across #IoT, mobile, desktop, backend, and browser, you do not need a prompt to rewrite the same business logic five times.

This week I flashed all the Seeed XIAO nRF52840 boards for my game colorhurry and sorted out the USB cables that only carry power. Next week at #ESEKongress in Sindelfingen, we look at the architecture behind those ten-LED boards and program them ourselves.

We connect two worlds: In the talk, we use #DDD and #Crux: events go in, effects come out, and one #RustLang core drives every target. In the workshop, we go from two hours of fundamentals straight to the #EmbeddedRust hardware, blink the ten LEDs, and connect our games via #BLE.

We close the workshop with the bridge between both sessions: \"How can I make sure buttons get pressed when I cannot press them myself?\"

Next week it starts. If you are up for it, drop by my two sessions:

Thursday, December 3, 2026, 14:45, Kleiner Saal: Ein Core für alle Fälle: Events rein, Effekte raus. Eine Logik für IoT, Mobile, Desktop, Backend und Browser. You see how a shared Domain Core eliminates platform rewrites from microcontrollers to web interfaces. https://ese-kongress.de/frontend/index.php?page_id=53095&v=List&do=15&day=6483&ses=46225#anker_session_46225

Friday, December 4, 2026, 09:30, Room Ib: Kompaktseminar: Rust von 0 auf 10 LEDs: Wir bauen ein BLE-Multiplayer-Spiel. You tame the borrow checker on real hardware with direct help whenever the compiler blocks you. https://ese-kongress.de/frontend/index.php?page_id=53095&v=List&do=15&day=6484&ses=46262#

Message me if you are in Sindelfingen.

Where do you see the bigger lever today: generating platform code with AI or sharing one Domain Core across targets?

#DomainDrivenDesign #EmbeddedSystems #SoftwareArchitecture #Microcontroller #nRF52840 #BluetoothLowEnergy #Rustaceans #ESE2026
